class.name: GameScene
class.brief_description: Base class for a stackable game scene. Intended to be inherited by game-specific scene scenes (menus, gameplay, pause, etc.). Provides lifecycle hooks that the Gam sceneManager calls when scenes are entered, exited, or updated each frame.
class.description:
This class represents a single scene in the game's scene stack. A `GameScene` is a `Node` that exposes three lifecycle callbacks that derived scenes may implement in GDScript or C++:
- `_on_enter()` is invoked when the scene becomes active (pushed). - `_on_exit()` is invoked when the scene is removed (popped). - `_on_update(delta)` is invoked each frame while the scene is active.
The `update_underneath` property controls whether scenes below the top of the stack should also receive update callbacks while this scene is active.

method.name: _on_enter
method.description: Called when this scene becomes the active top scene. Override to perform initialization or show animations.

method.name: _on_exit
method.description: Called when this scene is removed from the stack. Override to perform cleanup and stop running logic.

method.name: _on_update
method.description: Called each frame with the frame delta while this scene is active. Override to implement per-frame logic.
